pages.text:
A truck is on the
road.

Clinton Green has
a sack in the back.

What is in
the sack?
The kids come to him.
“What is in the sack?”

Can I
peek?
“I can see a lump in
the sack. Can I peek?”

Is it a bat
or a rat?
Is it a rock
or a log?
“Is it a bat or a rat?”
“Is it a rock or a
log?”

I can just
see a tail!
Is it a goanna
or a dog?
“I can just see a tail!”
“Is it a goanna or a
dog?”

It is a dog. The pup
fell asleep in the sack.

“Get up!”
The kids and the pup
run and jump.
